skill.summary: GEO售前快速钩子。输入客户品牌+5-8个头部竞品+1-2个签约词，5引擎并行采集，输出一张对比卡：客户排名末尾红色高亮，竞品头部绿色领先，一眼制造焦虑触发签约。触发词："售前钩子"、"快速分析"、"给销售出个报告"、"geo-quick-hook"、"客户现在多差"、"信源分析"、"竞品信源对比"。

latestVersion.changelog:
geo-quick-hook v1.0.0

- Initial release of the GEO售前快速钩子 (Pre-Sales Quick Hook) tool.
- Guides users through client brand, competitor, and keyword input to auto-generate a competitive comparison card.
- Integrates parallel data collection from 5 engines (Qwen, Doubao, DeepSeek, Kimi, Ernie).
- Outputs an HTML report, highlights client ranking, and automates report delivery via Feishu with screenshot.
- Designed to quickly create urgency in pre-sales scenarios by visualizing brand vs. competitor gaps.
